idea-plugin.name: JSP Highlight
idea-plugin.description:
Syntax highlighting for JavaServer Pages files in IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3 (unified product line), primarily for installations without the paid JSP support, where .jsp files otherwise open as plain text.
Highlighted constructs: template text, HTML tags and attributes, JSP comments (<%-- --%>), scriptlets (<% %>), expressions (<%= %>), declarations (<%! %>), directives (<%@ %>), and EL expressions (${...}, #{...}).
The plugin registers its own language id (JSP_HIGHLIGHT) and file type name, so it does not collide with JetBrains' JSP support if that ever becomes active.
